Name: Colorful Animals and Produce
Author: kettuluv
Description:
[size=3]Do you want you animals a bit more [color=#ff0000]c[/color][color=#ff7700]o[/color][color=#ffff00]l[/color][color=#00ff00]o[/color][color=#00ffff]r[/color][color=#8e7cc3]f[/color][color=#ff00ff]u[/color][color=#00ffff]l[/color]? Then this mod is for you!

This mod comes with 3 different palettes to choose from (see images for visuals):
[/size]
[size=3]- Bright Palette
- Pastel Palette
- Neon Palette

All barn and coop animals ([color=#ff0000]except[/color] for golden chicken and ostrich) have new colors to pick from. Their respective produce ([color=#ff0000]except[/color] for cheese, which remains [color=#ffff00]cheese colored[/color], and the truffle) has also changed to reflect the selected color.

There is a drop-down list for you to pick which palette you'd like with Generic Mod Config Menu, and the default is my favorite, the pastel palette! 

The animal shop icons have also changed to reflect your chosen palette as well.

I mostly made this mod for myself at first, but decided to make a couple more palettes to share with you all too!

Please let me know if you have any questions or comments, or any problems with the colors or images. I'll try to fix it as soon as I can!
[/size]
